ORIGINAL USMLE-STYLE PRACTICE

Time to a new plateau

A constant IV infusion of a hypothetical first-order drug is started with no loading dose. Its half-life is 6 hours and clearance remains stable. After 30 hours, approximately what fraction of the eventual steady-state concentration has been reached?

  1. Exactly 100%
  2. 97%
  3. 50%
  4. 75%
  5. 87.5%
Answer and explanation

97%

Thirty hours equals five half-lives. The fraction achieved is 1 − (1/2)^5 = 96.875%.

Option explanations

97%: Thirty hours equals five half-lives. The fraction achieved is 1 − (1/2)^5 = 96.875%.

50%: That is the fraction after one half-life.

75%: That is the fraction after two half-lives.

87.5%: That is the fraction after three half-lives.

Exactly 100%: The exponential approach is asymptotic; five half-lives is an approximation to steady state.
